text:
olivia: quick heads-up — ran a small smoke compare: SmoothQuant + AWQ vs GPTQ/FP8/INT8 for the new 13B-long model on 64k window. numbers and logs below. looking for regression sanity check before wider bakeoff. TL;DR: AWQ+SQ seems stable but FP8 hit quality delta on math evals. details:

sam: can you paste the eval harness config and seed?

olivia: paste config block:
```yaml
model: redwood/13b-long
context: 65536
quant: [awq-smooth, gptq-int8, fp8-e8m]
evals:
  - math-major
  - averaged-perf
seed: 42
batch_size: 4
```

marta: nice. what's the delta on MATH pass@1?

olivia: AWQ+SQ: pass@1 down 1.4% absolute. GPTQ INT8: down 2.9%. FP8 (e8m): down 5.8% and weird hallucination spikes on reasoning prompts. logs:
`math-pass1: baseline 72.6 -> awq+sq 71.2 -> gptq 69.7 -> fp8 66.8`

dev-bot: perf summary uploaded to S3: s3://redwood-ci/eng-ml/1759901234/sq-awq-64k-summary.json

kevin: do we have profiles for KV cache overflow / attention chunking at 64k? could be quant hitting attention kernels

olivia: yes — saw KV mem growth aligned with sequence length. SmoothQuant reduced activation peaks by ~18% which helped AWQ, but FP8 quantized layers with GELU outliers caused saturation. snippet from profiler:
`peak_act_reduction: smoothquant 18%`
`kv_cache_bytes: baseline 1.2GB -> awq+sq 1.05GB`

anya: any diff in latency tail? p95/p99

sam: measured on p3.2xlarge emulated: baseline p95 220ms/token, awq+sq p95 240ms/token (small increase), fp8 p95 210ms/token but with stability issues. p99 spiked for fp8 on long chains.

ben: interesting — FP8 has lower latency but lower quality. can we try hybrid where early layers FP8 and last 6 layers int8/awq?

olivia: tried hybrid: first 20 layers fp8, last 12 awq-int8 — quality improves to fp8-hybrid pass1 70.9, but still behind awq+sq 71.2. latency ~215ms.

ci-bot: nightly suite: regression alert created #regressions with label sq-awq-64k; linked job 1759901240

marta: can we run longer evals (1000 examples) on reasoning set? small n might be noisy.

olivia: yes kicking off a 1k-run now, ETA ~2h: job id 1759901299. will post summary.

kevin: add a focused prompt set that triggers gelu outliers (numeric reasoning & chain-of-thought) — I have a list, uploading in thread.

sam: thanks. also check alignment with tokenizer change (bpe merges) — that affected past longcontext runs.

olivia: noted, will add tokenizer snap in next run. thanks everyone :thumbsup: 

ci-bot: job 1759901299 started on runners cluster-3.
